Job Description

Do you enjoy coordinating campaigns, creating structure around recurring activities, and working closely with stakeholders across markets? Then this could be your opportunity to join JYSK's Email Marketing team at our Head Office in Aarhus.

We are expanding our team to strengthen our operational setup and explore new opportunities within gamification and permission marketing. As our new Gamification Coordinator, you will play an important role in ensuring that gamification activities run smoothly across multiple markets while contributing to subscriber growth and customer engagement. You will join an informal, social, and collaborative team where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, you become part of a large international retail organisation where your development matters. You will have the opportunity to deepen your expertise within gamification, email marketing, and digital customer engagement while working alongside experienced colleagues in a business that values initiative, responsibility, and cooperation. We believe that the best results are created together, and we support your professional and personal growth through close collaboration and learning opportunities.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A central role in a growing area with visibility across multiple markets

• The opportunity to work with gamification, email marketing, and subscriber growth initiatives

• A strong team culture built on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mutual support

• Responsibility from day one combined with sparring from experienced specialists and colleagues

• Professional development opportunities in a large international company where growth is part of our DNA

• Close cooperation with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales & Expansion, and local market teams

• An informal working environment where ideas and improvements are welcomed

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Gamification Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating day-to-day gamification activities and supporting the onboarding of new subscribers to JYSK's email marketing channels. Working closely with the Gamification Specialist and stakeholders across the business, you will help ensure high-quality execution, structured processes, and continuous optimisation of our gamification initiatives.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Planning and coordinating gamification campaigns and activities across JYSK markets

• Maintaining and updating campaign plans and yearly activity schedules

• Supporting the daily collaboration with our gamification platform provider

• Setting up campaigns and ensuring they follow agreed processes and timelines

• Supporting integration and testing activities between sign-up sources and marketing automation platforms

• Monitoring performance, preparing KPI reporting, and identifying opportunities for optimisation

• Supporting colleagues across markets with onboarding, training material, and operational guidance

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating multiple tasks, and working with stakeholders across different functions and markets. You are detail-oriented, comfortable with recurring operational tasks, and motivated by delivering consistent quality. At the same time, you are curious and eager to learn new technologies and ways of working.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has a degree within E-commerce, Digital Marketing, IT, or a similar relevant field

• Has an interest in gamification, customer engagement, and digital marketing

• Works in a structured and accurate manner, even when handling repetitive tasks

• Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively with stakeholders across different functions

• Is comfortable working with digital platforms, integrations, and testing processes

• Is eager to learn and continuously develop new knowledge within the field

• Experience with Playable, Bloomreach or similar platforms is an advantage but not a requirement

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader, Email Marketing, Martin Ry Mathiasen at +45 31 23 90 10.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

jobs.description:
Job title: Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Principal Scientist, you will play a key role in building a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research and contribute to shape how it turns emerging biology into molecular interventions. You will co-create new therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, design the molecules that test them and establish their pharmacological potential. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in medicinal chemistry, chemical biology, molecular pharmacology, peptide chemistry or a related discipline, typically complemented by at least eight years of relevant post-PhD research experience, or equivalent scientific contributions and leadership. Relevant experience may come from academia, biotechnology or the pharmaceutical industry.

• Deep expertise in molecular design and a strong understanding of how molecular properties influence pharmacological activity.

• A record of turning original ideas into experimental tools, therapeutic candidates or discovery projects, evidenced through publications, patents, project progression or other relevant contributions.

• Experience connecting chemistry with biological assays and in vivo findings to guide molecular optimisation.

• The ability to evaluate therapeutic modalities and select approaches suited to the target, mechanism and intended site of action.

• Experience leading scientific work and influencing decisions across multidisciplinary collaborations.

• Creativity, sound scientific judgement and a willingness to pursue unfamiliar approaches while testing assumptions rigorously.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Peptide engineering, peptide–drug conjugates or targeted delivery.

• Multi-receptor pharmacology or approaches combining complementary mechanisms.

• Neuropharmacology, cardiometabolic disease or healthspan research.

• Receptor pharmacology and mechanistic assay development.

• Collaborations connecting molecular design, synthesis and biological evaluation.

You are not expected to bring expertise across every modality or therapeutic area.

**What You Will Do

**You will provide scientific leadership at the interface of molecular design, biology and experimental pharmacology.

• Originate therapeutic concepts that connect biological mechanisms with opportunities for molecular intervention, and design molecular tools and drug candidates to establish pharmacological proof of concept.

• Develop strategies involving peptides, small molecules, conjugates or other modalities, choosing the approach that fits the biological question.

• Guide iterative molecular design using findings from in vitro assays, in vivo pharmacology and relevant DMPK studies.

• Contribute hands-on to experimental research, such as molecular preparation, characterisation or pharmacological evaluation, according to project needs and available capabilities.

• Identify technologies that expand our ability to modulate biological targets or deliver pharmacological activity.

• Assess evidence critically and recommend which concepts to advance, redirect or discontinue.

• Mentor colleagues and communicate molecular strategies, findings and recommendations across disciplines.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will shape the molecular innovation agenda of a new team and contribute to its first generation of discovery projects. The role combines scientific ownership with close involvement in experimental work, using emerging biological findings to guide the development of molecular approaches.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn emerging biology into molecular approaches that can change what we know about cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, apply for the Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery role by 22 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

• Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

Building the function

• Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

• A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• Competitive salary + company paid pension

• Private health insurance

• Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• Lunch subsidized by the company

• Company phone and company credit card

• Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter in English via our website: https://sparrowquantum.com/position?id=8695575

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

jobs.occupation: Advanced Laboratory Technician - In vivo Research
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**You will support in building the experimental foundation of a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, established to generate and validate innovative therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. As one of two Advanced Laboratory Technicians in In vivo Research, you will turn scientific questions into well-executed rodent studies and shape the team’s capabilities from the start. Your work helps bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline.

**What You Will Bring

**You are a trained laboratory technician, hold a relevant technical qualification, or bring equivalent practical experience.

• Strong hands-on experience in rodent research, including mouse and rat handling, dosing and sampling.

• Relevant training and authorisation for the animal procedures you will undertake, as applicable.

• A careful, organised approach to experimental work, documentation and data quality.

• The ability to work independently within agreed study plans and to coordinate with colleagues.

• Curiosity, practical problem-solving skills and an interest in learning new methods.

• Confidence in sharing observations, suggesting improvements and asking questions.

• The ability to communicate and document your work in English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Metabolic phenotyping, including food intake, body composition, glucose regulation or indirect calorimetry.

• Behavioural testing and neuroscience-related experimental methods.

• Rodent surgery and postoperative care.

• Tissue dissection, sample processing and ex vivo methods.

• In vitro assays supporting pharmacological or mechanistic studies.

• Establishing new laboratory methods or workflows.

You are not expected to bring experience in every technique. We welcome complementary profiles.

**What You Will Do

**Working closely with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians, you will contribute to studies that test new ideas and help set up how the team works in the lab. More specifically, you will:

• Plan, coordinate and perform mouse and rat pharmacology experiments, including dosing, observations, sampling and relevant physiological measurements.

• Perform metabolic phenotyping and contribute to behavioural studies, according to your expertise and training.

• Collect and process biological samples for ex vivo and laboratory analyses.

• Contribute to developing, optimising and troubleshooting experimental methods.

• Record, quality-check and organise experimental data, and flag observations that may affect interpretation or later studies.

• Bring practical expertise to study planning and to discussions of results.

• Help establish laboratory workflows, maintain equipment and coordinate materials and study activities, working to relevant procedures, animal welfare requirements and the principles of replacement, reduction and refinement.

Depending on your experience, you may also contribute to rodent surgery, specialised neuroscience methods or in vitro assays. Training will support the introduction of additional techniques.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, part of Research & Development, working alongside scientists and laboratory colleagues with expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Scientific and technical colleagues plan experiments together, deliver them together and interpret the observations together, so your view counts at every step. The team is headed by Christoffer Clemmensen.

You will also work with animal facility staff and laboratory specialists across the organisation.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will help shape the experimental practices of a new team. Your technical judgement, observations and suggestions will be valued as part of the research process, and you will be trusted to work independently within agreed study plans.

Salary and Benefits**:** The Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600.00 to 734,400.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Indutriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”).

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn scientific questions into well-executed studies and help build a new team’s lab from the ground up, apply for the Advanced Laboratory Technician – In vivo Research role by 22 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist, Upstream, Late-Stage Process Development
jobs.description:
**Are you an experienced upstream scientist who enjoys solving complex process challenges and turning scientific data into clear recommendations? Do you enjoy leading late-stage development studies and using your expertise to help clients move their processes towards clinical and commercial manufacturing?

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, we are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our Late-Stage Process Development team.

You will join a multidisciplinary team of six scientists and eight technicians working across upstream, downstream, and analytical disciplines. Together, we develop and characterize robust mammalian cell culture processes supporting clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Scientist, you will lead upstream late-stage development activities, with a particular focus on process characterization, down-scale model qualification, and scientific data analysis.

You will be responsible for your assigned scientific activities, from study design and data interpretation to technical recommendations and reporting. As a subject matter expert (SME), you will also serve as a key scientific contact for clients and internal stakeholders, helping explain process performance, address technical challenges, and recommend practical next steps.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Planning and leading process characterization (PC) studies, including experimental design, data evaluation, and preparation of PC work reports.

• Designing and evaluating down-scale model qualification (DSMQ) studies to demonstrate representativeness of manufacturing-scale processes.

• Applying statistical methods, including Design of Experiments (DoE), and tools such as JMP to support data-driven scientific conclusions.

• Contributing to FMECA and other process risk assessments to identify critical process parameters and support control strategy development.

• Supporting late-stage development activities, including Limit of In Vitro Cell Age (LIVCA) studies, Working Cell Bank (WCB) activities, scale-up, and technology transfer.

• Providing scientific guidance to laboratory technicians, collaborating across functions, and communicating technical findings, project status, and recommendations to clients.

You will also contribute to technical documentation, including development reports, technology transfer documentation, and relevant regulatory submissions.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced scientist with strong technical knowledge of mammalian upstream processes and the ability to translate scientific data into practical recommendations.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Hold a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in biotechnology, biochemical engineering, or another relevant scientific discipline.

• Have at least five years of relevant industry experience with a Master's degree or two years with a PhD, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Have solid experience with mammalian cell culture processes, including bioreactor operations and scale-up.

• Have experience with late-stage process development, such as process characterization, scale-down models, or technology transfer.

• Can design studies, apply statistical methods, interpret complex data, and communicate scientifically sound conclusions.

• Have experience with process risk assessments and preparing clear scientific reports and technical documentation.

• Communicate effectively with clients and cross-functional colleagues and are fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience with JMP, DoE, AMBR250, DSMQ, FMECA, statistical equivalence testing, process modelling, or regulatory submissions will be an advantage. We recognize that candidates may bring different combinations of these skills and do not expect you to have experience with every method or technology listed.

You work independently, take responsibility for your commitments, and maintain high standards of scientific quality. You can structure your work and prioritize competing tasks, even when project requirements change.

When challenges arise, you approach them calmly and logically, communicate openly about progress and risks, and involve colleagues or your manager when support is need.

You are comfortable discussing scientific findings with clients, explaining the rationale behind your recommendations, and working with others to resolve challenges. You value mutual respect, open communication, and learning from colleagues.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will work on different client projects, helping prepare mammalian upstream processes for clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to lead late-stage upstream development studies and work on different scientific and process challenges.

• A multidisciplinary environment where scientific discussions, collaboration, and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

• A manager who gives you room to plan your work independently, values honest discussions, and is available when you need support.

• An initial mentoring arrangement to help you become familiar with our processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**Interested?

**If you are motivated by combining scientific expertise, project responsibility, and client collaboration, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

**Expected Start Date: February 1, 2027

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Does it excite you to build a pharmacometrics function from the ground up, and do you have experience making model-informed drug development the way decisions get made? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

**Your new position

**As Head of Pharmacometrics, you will establish and lead pharmacometrics as a standalone, strategic capability within Medical & Science in Development & Manufacturing Sciences. You will be the key leader for implementing model-informed drug development (MIDD) as the operating principle of our development organization. The role owns the quantitative basis for dose selection, study design and candidate progression across the portfolio, with a focus on early clinical development. This is a founding role with the mandate to define the function, set the standards and recruit the team.

**We Offer Exciting Responsibilities

**

• Define and lead the MIDD strategy and roadmap, including which decisions must be model-informed at each toll gate

• Embed quantitative decision frameworks into the development process, project team deliverables and governance decisions

• Design model-informed studies and provide quantitative input to candidate selection and early go/no-go decisions

• Lead back-translation of clinical data to research, including model-based meta-analyses, and predict first-in-human doses

• Deliver exposure-response and population PK/PD modelling for dose confirmation, health authority interactions and submissions

• Build the function by setting modelling standards, defining the sourcing model, managing external vendors and recruiting the team

**Your profile

**You are a scientifically rigorous builder who is energized by creating something new and operates comfortably with ambiguity. You can translate complex modelling into clear recommendations for senior decision-makers, and you lead change by influencing how an organization makes decisions, not only how models are built. You collaborate easily across sites, time zones and partner organizations, and you take ownership and act boldly.

• PhD, PharmD or equivalent in pharmacometrics, clinical pharmacology, pharmaceutical sciences or a related quantitative discipline

• Extensive pharmacometrics experience in pharma or biotech, including leadership of people or a function

• Demonstrated experience implementing or substantially advancing MIDD within an organization, not only applying it to individual programs

• Track record in early clinical development, including preclinical-to-clinical translation, first-in-human dose prediction and Phase 1/2 dose selection

• Experience supporting late-stage decisions and health authority interactions, including authorship of regulatory modelling documentation

• Expertise in population modelling, exposure-response and simulation tools (e.g. NONMEM, R, Monolix or equivalent); experience in cardiometabolic, obesity or peptide drug development is an advantage

**Your new team

**You will report to the SVP, Medical & Science, and join the Medical & Science leadership team within Development & Manufacturing Sciences. As the founding leader of a new unit, you will start without direct reports and build the team as the function grows. You will work closely with Clinical Pharmacology, Translational Medicine, Medical, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Discovery Research and Patient Safety. The portfolio spans a Phase 3 obesity program co-developed with a global partner and a growing early-stage pipeline moving into the clinic.

**Let's bond and be bold

**We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let's bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than November 25, 2026, or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

For further information, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Caroline Nedergaard; CNedergaard@zealandpharma.com.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

**About Zealand Pharma A/S

**Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The Company has collaborations with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for research, development, and commercialization. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.
